hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; .venv/bin/ruff format "$f"; .venv/bin/ruff check "$f" >&2 || exit 2; uv run pyright >&2 || exit 2; }

branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); [ "$branch" = "eval/cbac-harness" ] || printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: current branch is '"$branch"', only eval/cbac-harness is allowed"}}'

jq -r ".tool_input.command" | grep -qE "(^|[;&|(] *)git( +-[a-zA-Z-]+([= ][^ ]+)?)* +commit([ ]|$)" && printf "%s" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"git commit is blocked by a PreToolUse hook in .claude/settings.local.json\"}}" || true
